summary: Senior ETL developer with about 6 years of data warehousing and ETL experience, progressing from production support analyst to DataStage developer and project lead. Deep expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage (8.5, 9.1, 11.5) for ETL/ELT across mainframe COBOL/ASCII sources and distributed RDBMS, with warehouses on Netezza, DB2, Oracle, SQL Server and Hive. Led large-scale enterprise migrations including Informatica-to-DataStage conversion (180 mappings), DataStage version upgrades (1000+ jobs), and a 100+ TB migration to Netezza. Covers the full SDLC from requirements and source-to-target design through production support, leading offshore and nearshore teams and delivering on schedule. Also built Hadoop/Hive data archival frameworks using Unix shell scripting.
